name: software-controlled-skills-multiplatform-kit
title: v2.3.0 — Index-aware Task Creation & Controlled Execution
description: Split multi-platform software development skills with graph-aware project indexing, index-aware task creation and controlled execution, and fixed completion summary format.
updates_from_v2_2: Enhanced software-task-creation to generate index-aware task prompts without replacing the existing prompt structure.
Enhanced controlled-software-task-execution with Pre-execution Index Check, Pre-edit Impact Check, validation selection, and Post-execution Index Maintenance.
Added index maintenance outcomes: no-index-update-needed, incremental-index-update, and full-index-refresh-required.
Added index-aware completion summary sections while preserving the existing Fixed Completion Summary Format.
Updated task templates and examples with AI index files to read, affected tests mapping, validation plan, stop conditions, allowed files, forbidden files, and index maintenance expectations.
Kept project-indexing intact; CodeGraph optional, not required.
Added no dependency / CI / package changes.
updates_from_v2_1: Upgraded only project-indexing to Graph-aware Project Indexing.
Added index source priority for authority documents, AI indexes, optional structured code intelligence, repository scans, and fallback raw search.
Added structured code intelligence detection for CodeGraph, code graph MCP tools, symbol / AST / call graph, dependency graph, and test impact graph.
Enhanced PROJECT_INDEX_TEMPLATE.md with graph-aware sections for entry points, key symbols / modules, dependency summary, critical flows, fallback reasons, and uncertainty logs.
Enhanced TEST_INDEX_TEMPLATE.md with source area to affected tests mapping.
Kept CodeGraph optional and non-authoritative; no dependencies, npm scripts, MCP config, or package manager files are required.
updates_from_v2_0: Added fixed completion summary format to controlled-software-task-execution.
Added mandatory completion summary requirement to software-task-creation.
Added index completion summary format to project-indexing.
Updated task templates with stage boundary and summary requirements.
